# Local, Carefully Sourced Groceries from Our Family to Yours

## Experience the heartfelt service of a traditional, local grocer—and the latest food and beverage trends—in northern Kentucky [...] Everyone is family at Kremer’s Market—customers, staff and owners. Since Urban Kremer built the big red barn at Buttermilk Pike and Overlook Drive in Crescent Springs, Kentucky in 1977, we have focused on sourcing and serving the best ingredients and prepared foods for families—with the most friendly and knowledgeable staff. Ask customers who have shopped with us for decades or drop by yourself to enjoy the difference.
